confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from crowd-sourced guides and one Algarve bar-price study, which disagree on beer and wine, so they are less certain than the restaurant meal figures. Cocktail rests on a single undated guide. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings. The EUR-to-USD conversion used a rate of about 1.12 USD per EUR, derived from an RBA AUD/USD observation and a third-party AUD/EUR figure for 16 Oct 2026 that I could not verify. The FX observation is the RBA AUD/USD 0.6955 for 15 Oct 2026, as shown on the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page in search results; I did not open the page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Algarve resort-town basis: Albufeira-specific cost-of-living guides, Algarve restaurant and bar price reports, and Faro and Alvor comparisons for drinks. Accommodation uses a holistic estimate of summer-peak resort pricing in the Algarve, with no listing searches.
